title: jazzed moroccan eggplant tagine
description: herbal, shaggy, festive moroccan dish featuring prosciutto, yakimono-grill, dash-friendly, form=zaalouk
instructions: preheat oven to 400f. heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat. add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes. add the garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
add the cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
add the eggplant and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. add the prosciutto and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, about 3 minutes.

stir in the chopped parsley and lemon juice. bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggplant is tender, about 10 minutes. add the water and bring the mixture to a simmer. cover the tagine and transfer to the preheated oven.
bake for 20 minutes or until the eggplant is tender and the liquid has thickened slightly. remove the tagine from the oven and let stand for 5 minutes before serving.
